approach: Add one reading check, `check_real_records_command(reading, request)`, in crates/athena-core/src/reading/surveys.rs. It runs as one new `step!` line in `refusing_check`, after `check_scope_limit` (checks.rs:547) and before `check_boundary_and_repo_files` (checks.rs:548). It examines the Behavior criteria of a reading that has a capability. A criterion is flagged when it runs an athena command, names the real records/ queue, and has no stand-in place, no `--snapshot` and no Depends exemption in the request. Commands: `athena <sub>`, or `cargo run ... athena-cli ... -- <sub>` (also `--bin athena`), with `<sub>` one of status, plan, queue, drain, drain-status, retry, go, land, backtest. A `-- <sub>` that does not follow `cargo run` with athena-cli, such as `cargo test -p athena-core -- plan`, is not a command. Real-records phrases: real records (also `real-records`), records/ queue, repository's records, repo's records, real queue, live records, live queue. A stand-in counts only as a place: a stand-in word (fixture, fixtures, temp, tmp, temporary, synthetic) within three words after a place word (on, in, against, with, using, into, from), and not when a negation (not, never, no, without, instead, than) directly precedes that place word. `sample` is not an exemption. The request exemption is `dependency_ids_in(request)` (topics.rs:25) containing 20261030-070002-d103: only a 'Depends on' line or the retry link counts, never a bare mention. The error names each flagged criterion by number and text and gives three repairs. (a) For the reader: `cargo run -p athena-cli -- status --snapshot <evidence directory>`, which reads the read-only evidence copy Athena makes for every job (run/mod.rs:1174-1175, briefs.rs:655-672). (b) A fixture or temp directory. (c) For the request author: depend on job 20261030-070002-d103 with a line `Depends on 20261030-070002-d103`. The `--snapshot` form is exempt because it does not read records/ (briefs.rs:671: the working copy still has no records/) and it is the form `check_records_measure` asks for (surveys.rs:593-595). Tests: unit tests in reading.rs built from the e5sg and sz3z shapes, a measure-reading test showing the error's `--snapshot` repair passes both checks, and 13 corpus cases. A CHANGELOG item records the check. No prompt text changes. Root cause: nothing compared the commands a criterion runs with what the producer's and verifier's working copy holds (no records/, briefs.rs:671), so criteria that need the real queue were admitted and could not be met. The check sits in the shared gate, not in one reading.

decisions.choice: Settle finding 1 (major): the error offers three repairs, and the one the reader can use is the `--snapshot` form. The error says the working copy has no records/. (a) Reader: run `cargo run -p athena-cli -- status --snapshot <evidence directory>`, which reads the evidence copy; `plan` and the other commands have no such form. (b) Run the command on a fixture or a temp directory that the change or test builds. (c) Request author: the job must depend on job 20261030-070002-d103 with a line `Depends on 20261030-070002-d103`; the reader cannot add it, so it uses (a) or (b). A criterion containing `--snapshot` is never flagged.
decisions.reason: Read: reader.rs `refusal_section` (reader.rs:395) puts the error into the one re-read (reading.rs:732-740, `read_for`). The reader cannot edit the request, so (c) alone cannot pass. check_records_measure (surveys.rs:538-602, run earlier at checks.rs:541) needs a Behavior criterion with `real records`, an independent source and an `expected range`, and it does not need `--snapshot`. So 'Run `athena status` on the real records ... expected range from history.json' passes it and is then refused here; only the `--snapshot` form passes both. The evidence copy exists for every dispatched job (run/mod.rs:1174-1175) and both briefs name its path (briefs.rs:655-672, `evidence_section`). The `--snapshot` command runs in records_criteria.rs:221-232 on that copy. HISTORY.txt:1104 shows the snapshot work landed (commit 823dd32). Existing tests pass `--snapshot` criteria with gate_refuser None: reading.rs:8350, 8412, 8424, 8563, 8573 and corpus 354 and 441. The check's own error example for check_records_measure is the `--snapshot` command (surveys.rs:593-595). The new unit test `real_records_measure_reading_is_told_the_snapshot_form` shows a measure reading with the plain command is refused by check_real_records_command, and the same reading rewritten as the error says is accepted by refusing_check.

decisions.choice: Settle finding 4: tighten the lexical match and list the limits. (1) The `-- <sub>` form counts only after `cargo run` with `athena-cli` or `--bin athena` before the ` -- `, never after `cargo test`. (2) A stand-in counts only as a place: a stand-in word within 3 words after a place word, with no negation directly before the place word. (3) `sample` and any bare mention of a stand-in word elsewhere are not exemptions. (4) The phrase search reads hyphens as spaces (`real-records`), the command and `--snapshot` search does not. Limits in the doc comment: no negation or tense reading beyond the place word; a criterion that runs the command on a fixture and then on the real records is exempt; a bare 'Run `status` on the real records' names no athena and is not caught (reading.rs:8452 shape); `cargo run -- status` with no athena-cli is not caught; a criterion saying 'athena status ... real records' without running it is flagged; the sz3z wording is a guess.
decisions.reason: Text is normalised with `straight_lowercase` (surveys.rs:286) after backticks become spaces; `has_phrase` (surveys.rs:39) gives whole-word matching; `plain_words` (surveys.rs:876) splits the stand-in search on non-alphanumerics, so `/tmp` reads as `tmp`. The old rule needed only 'athena' anywhere for `-- <sub>`, so `cargo test -p athena-core -- plan` plus 'real records' matched, and any one exemption word cleared a criterion, so 'not a fixture' passed. Unit test `real_records_matching_limits` and corpus cases `real-records-cargo-test-filter` and `real-records-command-not-a-fixture` pin these.

decisions.choice: Exit table for the new check (a pure function, no stage, no I/O): success: `Ok(())` when the reading has no capability, no Behavior criterion is flagged, or the request depends on d103; the `step!` macro (checks.rs:527-533) goes on to the next check. fail: `bail!` with the refusal text; `step!` returns `Some(("check_real_records_command", error))`; `read_for` (reading.rs:732-740) turns it into the refusal, re-reads once with the text (`refusal_section`, reader.rs:395), and `check_reading_acceptance` (checks.rs:492-503) returns `Err`; a stored refusal carries the rule name as a string, which hestia.rs:686-692 reads as a free string. error: cannot happen (no I/O, no spawn, no lock); a parse failure inside `dependency_ids_in` gives an empty list (topics.rs:33-39), so the result is a refusal, not an error. hold: cannot happen (no queue or record state is read or written). interrupt: cannot happen (no wait or long call).
decisions.reason: Every exit is the existing step! contract, so no new state or record is written, and the code that reads the outcome next is `read_for`, `check_reading_acceptance`, `check_reading_text` (replay.rs:54-65), steward.rs:424 and 2765, and main.rs:709 (`athena check-reading`).

demonstrations.method: A new unit test in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, written like `records_measure_has_one_step_line` (reading.rs:8698-8722) and `scope_limit_has_one_step_line` (reading.rs:8978-8990). It uses `reading_source()` (reading.rs:1590), which joins checks.rs and surveys.rs. It asserts the signature is in surveys.rs, that exactly one line of the `refusing_check` body trims to `step!(check_real_records_command(reading, request));` (line equality, so the quoted copy in the test does not count), that its neighbours are the `check_scope_limit` and `check_boundary_and_repo_files` lines, that `check_reading_acceptance` has no `check_` call (corpus 3210), and that the doc of `check_reading_acceptance` links [`check_real_records_command`].
demonstrations.observes: Passes with one public function and one step line between scope_limit and boundary; fails on any other shape.
demonstrations.fails_without: The test fails if the step line is missing or duplicated, sits somewhere else, the function is not `pub fn check_real_records_command(reading: &Reading, request: &str) -> Result<()>` in surveys.rs, or the doc of check_reading_acceptance omits it.
demonstrations.seam: Exists: `reading_source()` (reading.rs:1590), which reads the source text of checks.rs and surveys.rs. No fake. The test is added by plan step 4.

demonstrations.method: The test builds a Behavior criterion with `governed_reading` and `add_behavior` (reading.rs:4647, 4794): 'Run `athena status` on the real records and report the landed jobs'. It calls `check_real_records_command(&reading, request)` with a request that has no Depends line. It asserts the error contains 'criterion 1', the criterion text, 'depend on job 20261030-070002-d103', 'Depends on 20261030-070002-d103', 'fixture', 'temp', 'cargo run -p athena-cli -- status --snapshot <evidence directory>' and 'has no records/'. It then asserts Ok for the request forms: a dash line `- Depends on 20261030-070002-d103`, `1. Depends on 20261030-070002-d103`, `1) depends on 20261030-070002-d103`, `Depends on: 20261030-070002-d103`, and a line that also lists another job. It asserts Err for 'see 20261030-070002-d103', '20261030-070002-d103 landed', and 'Depends on 20260101-000000-abcd'. The same reading with no capability is Ok.
demonstrations.observes: Error text carries the number, text and the three repairs; Ok exactly when dependency_ids_in holds d103; the dependency line is the only request exemption.
demonstrations.fails_without: An exemption that read the id text anywhere would make the bare-mention and other-dependency cases pass instead of failing; an error without the number, the text, `status --snapshot`, the fixture repair or the Depends repair fails the text assertions.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point: `check_real_records_command` (new, surveys.rs) and inside it the existing `dependency_ids_in` (topics.rs:25). The fixture is an in-memory `Reading` from `governed_reading` and `add_behavior` (exist). Nothing is faked: the dependency rule runs on the request text. Added by plan step 4.

demonstrations.method: New unit tests in reading.rs, all named `real_records_...`. (a) `real_records_e5sg_shape_...`: a Behavior criterion 'Run `athena status` on the real records and check the figure'. `refuser_for(&reading, request)` (reading.rs:7300) is Some("check_real_records_command") without a Depends line and None with 'Depends on 20261030-070002-d103'. `check_reading_text` (replay.rs:54) gives Refuse naming 'real records', and Accept with the line. (b) `real_records_sz3z_shape_...`: 'Run `cargo run -p athena-cli -- plan` against this repository's records/ queue and list what it plans', same two outcomes. (c) `real_records_stand_ins_snapshot_content_...` (not refused): 'Run `athena status` on a fixture records directory', 'Run `athena plan` in a temp dir with a fixture queue', 'Run `cargo run -p athena-cli -- status --snapshot evidence`: on the real records the landing time ...', 'No file under records/ changes', 'Run `cargo test`: the real records are not read', a Content criterion 'The guide says to run `athena status` on the real records', and a reading with no capability. (d) `real_records_matching_limits`: 'Run `cargo test -p athena-core -- plan`: the real records are not read' is not flagged; 'Run `athena status` on the real records, not a fixture', '... not on a fixture', '... and sample two jobs' and 'Run `athena plan` on the real-records queue' are flagged; a bare 'Run `status` on the real records' is not flagged (limit). (e) `real_records_measure_reading_is_told_the_snapshot_form`: `measure_reading(LANDING_TIME_SUMMARY, &["crates/athena-core/src/status.rs"], PLAIN)` (reading.rs:8355) with PLAIN 'Run `athena status` on the real records: the landing time it prints is within the expected range taken from the commit times in history.json'. `gate_refuser` is Some("check_real_records_command") (check_records_measure passes it), the error holds `cargo run -p athena-cli -- status --snapshot <evidence directory>`, and the criterion rewritten with that command gives `gate_refuser` None and `accept` Ok. The plain criterion with a d103 Depends request also gives None.
demonstrations.observes: Refused without the dependency and accepted with it, for both shapes and through both the gate and the stored-reading seam; stand-in, snapshot, unchanged, content and no-capability forms accepted; the matching limits as listed; the repair the error names passes both check_records_measure and the new check.
demonstrations.fails_without: With no check, the e5sg and sz3z tests get `refuser_for(...)` None and fail their `Some("check_real_records_command")` assertions; a check that exempted any stand-in word or a bare `--` fails the limits test; a check that ignored the Depends line fails the with-dependency assertions.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points: `refusing_check` (checks.rs:520), `check_reading_acceptance` (checks.rs:492) and `check_reading_text` (replay.rs:54). The readings are built in memory with the existing helpers `governed_reading`, `add_behavior`, `add_content`, `code_reading`, `history_reading`, `measure_reading`, `gate_refuser` and `refuser_for` (reading.rs:4647, 4794, 7054, 7284, 8355, 7295, 7300). All exist; no fake; the tests are added by plan step 4. If an earlier check refuses a case first, the producer adds an `Environment:` assumption to that base reading and does not weaken the matcher.

demonstrations.method: The verifier's snapshot is a two-commit repository, base then candidate (run/mod.rs:2069-2073), so `git diff --stat HEAD~1 HEAD` lists the candidate's changed paths. Expect CHANGELOG.md, surveys.rs, checks.rs, reading.rs and refusal_corpus.rs, and no path under records/, no athena.toml, no defaults.toml, no .github/workflows/ file. The verifier also runs `cargo test -p athena-core real_records_check_doc_and_changelog_declare_the_share`: the test reads the `///` block above `check_real_records_command` and the first Unreleased CHANGELOG item that contains `reading::check_real_records_command` (the pattern of reading.rs:8996-9061), and asserts each holds 'higher refusal rate is intended', 'expected 3% of newly refused readings', 'estimate', 'Depends on 20261030-070002-d103', 'status --snapshot', the jobs 20261029-233021-e5sg and 20261030-125332-sz3z, and 'wording guessed'. It also asserts the item does not contain `reading::check_scope_limit`, `reading::check_records_measure`, `reading::check_history_fixture` or `reading::check_defined_terms`.
demonstrations.observes: The diff lists CHANGELOG.md and the four code files and nothing under records/, athena.toml, defaults.toml or .github/workflows/; the share test passes.
demonstrations.fails_without: A missing CHANGELOG item or a missing doc declaration fails the new share test; a stray edit of a governance or records file shows in the diff list.
demonstrations.seam: Existing: git on the verifier's two-commit snapshot, and the `include_str!("../../../CHANGELOG.md")` plus doc-comment pattern of reading.rs:9008-9029. The share test is added by plan step 4 and the item by step 6.
